 I’ve been trying to connect with you to schedule your EasyPay training session. This training is an essential step to ensure your team is fully equipped to maximize the benefits of our platform and provide the best experience for customers.

Please reply to this email with your preferred date and time or give me a call at (866) 854-8555, and I’ll follow up with a meeting link for your preferred time.

 Our team is available Monday through Friday from 6 AM to 3:30 PM PT. Let us know what works best for you within this timeframe.

 Looking forward to hearing from you soon!

Best,
 Michael Palmer
 (702) 850-3090
 EasyPay Finance 
 EasyPay Finance: PO Box 2549 Carlsbad, CA 92018
For information regarding EasyPay Finance's Programs, visit https://www.easypayfinance.com/programs.
Email Preference Center

I told him that the only way to recover the funds would be to cancel the application which also have the customer reapply and redo the entire application over again. I warned him that doing this could be dangerous because the customer may not agree to even fill out the application again once they realize that they won’t be on the hook for the funds since the original contract have been canceled. He understood and decided against canceling the applications. Instead, he asked if I could look up who redeemed the spiffs for those apps. He gave me the app IDs and I am going to ask LUZ to look them up. I will call him back once I get an answer.
